title: Mobber
description: Random item, random mob, random structure will be give/spawned every several seconds
body:
## Mobber

Mobber brings pure chaotic energy into Minecraft by spawning **random items**, **random mobs**, and **random structures** at intervals you choose.

Just set the timers with commands and watch the world descend into beautiful nonsense.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/9BNm3MKDT3M" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

---

### ⭐ Commands

```

/randomItemTimeSet <seconds>
/randomMobTimeSet <seconds>
/randomStructureTimeSet <seconds>
/randomEventMessagesInChat <true/false>

```

Timers use integers. Messages accept true/false.

---

### 🎮 Why use this mod?

- Chaos for SMP events  
- Perfect for content creators  
- Works great for challenge videos  
- Turns survival into unpredictable madness  

---

### 📦 Requirements

- Fabric Loader  
- Fabric API
